mechanism.base: Earth feeds Metal. Within the rock, moisture gathers around the ore, and the material of a blade takes form before there is any edge to see. The ore stays rough. What the forge can work is first held in the earth, where metal waits for the cut that will give it use.
mechanism.friction_turn: Run heavy, the edge stalls beside a growing heap of ore. More preparation keeps the work waiting. Test one idea before opening another book.

friction.clause: The edge stalls beside a growing heap of ore.
friction.remedy: Test one idea before opening another book.

function.definition_friction: Earth is your Mind, and as a friction, it is preparation that keeps asking for more. Your notes get longer and your reading list fills up while the decision waits. You have plenty to draw from. Taking in another explanation becomes easier than putting your own work to the test.
function.advise_friction: You can use understanding to postpone the risk of being seen trying. Set a stopping time for research each day. Keep a draft beside your notes and change it after each study session. Once a week, show someone the unfinished work. Start with a sentence.

candidates.cta_verdict: You take time to make sense of what you learn, so decisions can stall when another explanation matters more than trying an answer.

mechanism.base: Metal is born of earth, the old texts say: it lies in the mountain, gathered in stone, grown by slow pressure and the moisture of deep ground. Nothing hurries it. The mountain holds the ore for ages before any edge is struck from it, and every blade remembers the patience of the rock that made it.
mechanism.friction_turn: Run heavy, the shelter closes over the blade: so much preparation that the edge never leaves the mine. Comfort begins to bury what it formed. Dig out and cut something real.

friction.clause: The shelter closes over the blade: so much preparation that the edge never leaves the mine.
friction.remedy: Dig out and cut something real.

function.definition_friction: Earth is your Mind, and as a friction, it is intake with no off switch. Study, comfort, preparation, shelter: everything that goes in counts as progress, so nothing ever has to come out. Learning becomes the most respectable way to stand still.
function.advise_friction: At some point more learning is just fear with a reading list. Trade study for evidence: for every hour that goes in, one small thing comes out where someone can see it. Give each research topic a decision date. Finish one old course before any new one gets your money.

$original.cta_verdict: Your mind takes things in slowly and keeps them forever, and your best judgments are the ones you let sit overnight.
